title: Expense import
subtitle: Bring card spending into Spending. Nothing is saved until you review it.
settings_sub: Choose how card spending comes in and where it goes.
off_body: Turn on statement import or the Apple Pay link in the module settings.
upload_body: CSV or XLSX from Wise, Revolut, ING or BT. Any other bank works after you match its columns once.
undo_confirm: Move the expenses from this import to Recently deleted? You can restore them for 30 days.
discard_confirm: Discard this import? Nothing from it has been saved.
review_sub: Tick what should become an expense. Income, refunds, transfers and possible duplicates start unticked.
done_undone: This import was undone. Its expenses are in Recently deleted.
map_sub: We don't know this statement's layout yet. Match its columns once and we'll remember it for this bank.
map_expenses_positive: Money out is written as a positive number
statements_desc: Upload CSV/XLSX statements and review them before saving.
shortcut_desc: An iPhone Shortcut sends each Apple Pay payment (amount + shop) to your personal link.
defaults_desc: The list and payer a new import starts with. You can change both on the review screen.
auto_save: Save Apple Pay payments straight away
auto_save_hint: Off: each payment waits in your review queue. On: it's added to Spending right away (and can be undone).
link_desc: Only for you: payments sent to it are added as you. Anyone with the link can add expenses, so keep it private.
link_none: You don't have a link yet.
setup_title: Set it up on your iPhone
setup_1: Install the Familywell shortcut (button above), or make your own: Shortcuts > + > "Get Contents of URL" with your link, method POST, JSON body: amount = Shortcut Input's Amount, merchant = Shortcut Input's Merchant.
setup_2: Paste your personal link when the shortcut asks for it.
setup_3: Shortcuts > Automation > + > Transaction: pick your cards (e.g. Wise), choose "Run Immediately", and run the Familywell shortcut.
setup_4: Pay with Apple Pay once to test: the payment shows up here for review.
setup_note: Works for Apple Pay payments made with your phone or watch, not the physical card. Some cards don't share the shop name with Shortcuts; then the payment comes in as "Apple Pay" and you can rename it.
admin_only: Only family admins can change these settings.
error_unreadable: That file couldn't be read. Upload a CSV or XLSX statement.
error_no_table: No transactions table was found in that file.
error_empty: No transactions were found in that statement.
error_mapping_empty: No rows could be read with these columns. Check the date and amount columns.
error_list: You can't add expenses to that list.
pay_queued: :amount · :merchant is waiting for review in Familywell.
pay_failed: Couldn't add :amount · :merchant. Open Familywell to add it by hand.
pay_bad_amount: No amount in a supported currency (EUR, RON, USD, GBP) was sent.
pay_no_subscription: This family has no active Familywell subscription.
